name: Affilia – Affiliate Program for WooCommerce
author: RedefiningTheWeb

sections.description:
Affilia – Affiliate Program for WooCommerce (Lite) is a free WooCommerce affiliate plugin to create and manage an affiliate system for your WordPress eCommerce store. Easily recruit affiliates, track their referrals, pay commissions, and grow your store’s revenue with the power of performance marketing.

This plugin is beginner-friendly, easy to set up, and flexible enough to handle growing affiliate programs. Whether you’re just starting out or need a scalable solution, Affilia has you covered.

Upgrade to the Premium version for advanced features like level-wise commissions, lifetime tracking, subscription support, detailed reporting, affiliate ranking, and more.

🚀 Top Free Features

  • Unlimited Affiliates: Add and manage unlimited affiliates for your WooCommerce store.
  • Referral Tracking: Track referrals through affiliate links or codes.
  • Fixed/Percentage Commission: Assign fixed or percentage-based commissions for product referrals.
  • Affiliate Dashboard: Clean and simple front-end dashboard for each affiliate to track their performance.
  • Manual Commission Entry: Admin can manually assign commissions.
  • Referral Coupon Support: Assign discount coupons to affiliates.
  • Wallet System: Affiliates can view and redeem their commissions.
  • Commission Rules: Set different commission rules per product or category.
  • Email Notifications: Notify affiliates about commissions, signups, and more.
  • Shortcodes: Use shortcodes for registration, login, dashboard, and more.

🛠 Easy Integration

  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce
  • No coding knowledge required
  • Works seamlessly with popular WordPress themes and builders

💡 Use Cases

  • Launch an affiliate program for your online store
  • Allow influencers and bloggers to promote your products
  • Offer referral discounts to increase customer engagement

🔐 GDPR and Security

We respect user privacy and data protection:
– Compliant with GDPR guidelines
– No personal data is sent to any third-party services

📈 Upgrade to PRO

Unlock advanced features with the Premium Version:

  • 🧩 Level-wise Commission: Create tiered levels with conditions like sales volume or referral count (Not MLM).
  • 🔄 Two-Way Commission: Reward both affiliates and customers on referral purchases.
  • 🏷️ Affiliate Coupons: Allow affiliates to generate and share discount codes.
  • 📊 Advanced Reporting & Charts: Visualize performance, traffic, and commissions.
  • 🧾 Signup & Rank Bonus: Offer rewards on affiliate sign-up or rank upgrades.
  • 🔁 Lifetime Commission: Track referrals even without cookies for future purchases.
  • 🔄 WooCommerce Subscription Support: Pay commissions on renewals.
  • 🎯 Commission by Product Tags: Assign commissions based on product tags.
  • 👁️ Real-time Registration Preview: Customize registration templates with live preview.
  • 📥 Multiple Payout Options: Pay via PayPal, Stripe, Paystack, or coupons.
  • 🪪 Parent-Child Affiliates: Set parent relationships between affiliates.
  • ⚙️ Ajax-based fast page templates (no page reload).
  • ✅ Customizable Emails and templates
  • 📱 Share on Social Media – With this functionality, an affiliate can share the product’s affiliate link on social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, Mail, and WhatsApp.
  • 💰 Performance Bonuses, Monthly Limits, Device-based Reports, and much more…

👉 Upgrade Now →

Multi Level Marketing ( MLM )

You can choose any MLM Matrix from Binary, Forced Matrix and Unilevel and start earning money through your MLM members. You can set a number of children and the levels of the MLM chain. You can even set a commission for each level. Add a multilevel marketing strategy to your affiliate program so that your affiliate will generate new leads, which will increase the sale amount even further with the help of 3 Multi-level Marketing Matrix – Binary MLM, Forced Matrix MLM, Unilevel MLM.

❌ Features not available in the Lite version

🚀 Advanced Commission & Bonus Features

  • Level-wise commission (multi-level affiliate system)
  • Two-way commission (user & affiliate both get a benefit)
  • Coupon-based commission (no referral link needed)
  • Signup bonus for new affiliates
  • Rank bonus system for affiliates
  • Lifetime commission (persistent user-affiliate linkage)
  • Manual referral/commission assignments
  • Subscription renewal commission
  • Commission per affiliate, per product tag
  • Set the parent of affiliates (affiliate hierarchy)

📈 Affiliate Tools & Reports

  • Advanced affiliate tools
  • Dynamic HTML banners
  • QR codes for referral links
  • Social media sharing
  • Dynamic charts: sales overview, earnings, clicks, conversions, etc.
  • Advanced reporting tab:
  • Sales/month
  • Visits, orders, revenue
  • Device-based purchase medium report
  • Performance bonus based on affiliate success
  • Monthly commission limits
  • Separate commission/payout/profile tables per affiliate
  • Admin panel with detailed affiliate profiles and traffic info

💳 Payout & Wallet Enhancements

  • Payout options via:
    • PayPal
    • Stripe
    • Paystack
    • Bank Transfer
  • Ability to shop using wallet balance (via coupons)
  • Wallet-based affiliate shopping support
  • Allow affiliates to generate coupons from earnings

🛠 Admin & Customization Tools

  1. Commission rules based on:
    • All products
    • Specific products
    • Specific categories
    • Fixed/percentage/combined
    • Real-time preview of the affiliate registration template
    • Reload-free page templates (faster UI)
    • Ability to set commission by product category and date range
  2. Customized emails (activate/deactivate affiliate mails)

👥 User & Tracking Enhancements

  • Ability for affiliates to see the commission per product
  • Show member name in referral tab
  • Option for admins to enable/disable referral name display
  • Toggle between referral link or referral code tracking

🚀 Want to unlock MLM, direct payouts, coupons, bonus rewards, and more?
Upgrade to Affilia Premium and supercharge your affiliate program today!

sections.installation:
Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option as WordPress handles the file transfers itself, and you don’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of WooCommerce Order Coupon, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu and click Add New.

In the search field, type “Affilia Lite – Affiliate Program With MLM ” and click Search Plugins. Once you’ve found our Affilia Lite – Affiliate Program With MLM Plugin, you can view details about it, such as the point release, rating, and description. Most importantly, of course, you can install it by simply clicking “Install Now”.

Manual installation

The manual installation method involves downloading our Affilia Lite – Affiliate Program With MLM Plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favourite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here (https://codex.wordpress.org/Managing_Plugins#Manual_Plugin_Installation).
sections.faq:
Does Affilia support WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes, Affilia is fully compatible with the latest WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) features.

Can I use Affilia with any WordPress theme?

Absolutely! Affilia works with any properly coded WordPress theme.

Is MLM support included in the free version?

No, MLM (Binary, Forced Matrix, Unilevel) is available in the premium version. You can explore it here.

Can affiliates earn from their own purchases?

Yes, Affilia supports “Own Referral” so affiliates can earn from their own orders.

Is Affilia GDPR compliant?

Affilia does not store any personal data outside WordPress and WooCommerce, keeping your store GDPR compliant.

How do affiliates track their performance?

Affiliates get access to a dedicated dashboard with stats, referral links, banners, and QR code tools.

Can I automate payouts?

Yes, the premium version supports PayPal & Stripe payouts directly from the dashboard.

Can I create conditional or product-based commissions?

Yes! You can set commissions by product, category, or sitewide—including fixed, percentage, or both.

Does it support multilingual websites?

Yes, Affilia is translation-ready and works with popular multilingual plugins like WPML, Loco Translate, and Polylang.

Can I manually add commissions?

Yes, the plugin allows admins to manually assign commissions.

Can affiliates earn commission on subscription renewals?

This feature is available in the premium version.

Is multi-level marketing (MLM) supported?

Yes, you can choose from Binary, Forced Matrix, Unilevel and Unlimited
